verdicts.reason: A has a strong hierarchy with a big headline and a clear CTA, but its left edges don't line up: the logo and subhead sit at x≈76 while the headline sits at x≈64. The headline almost touches the right edge, the CTA floats above the flavour chips so the reading order is off, and the pink circle is cropped awkwardly at the top right. B breaks the headline badly, leaving 'here' alone on its own line. Its top half is mostly empty apart from a yellow blob that has nothing to do with the rest, the text is crammed into the bottom left, and the chips form an uneven two-plus-one grid on top of the pink circle, so the right-hand cluster feels arbitrary and the layout is badly balanced.
